topLine: A very quiet day for NSW state politics, with almost nothing of substance in the overnight cycle. The only item of note is a Sydney Morning Herald feature on the Liberal Party's internal direction, profiling a 29-year-old self-described "rebel" positioned as a potential renewal figure. No NSW election, government or integrity developments were reported.

stories.headline: The Liberal Party is drowning. This 29-year-old ‘rebel’ wants to be its lifeboat
stories.summary: The Sydney Morning Herald profiles a 29-year-old Liberal described as a "rebel" who, in the Herald's framing, sees himself as a vehicle for rescuing a struggling party. Only the headline is available, so the detail of the argument and the figures involved is not set out in the supplied text.
